results.reason: Issue 1 computes the Section 3.2 deadline as August 16, 2026 and notes that Schedule 3.12 says the Company only 'intends' to deliver the notice. It explains the agreement expires November 14, 2026, before the November 30 closing, and that the Section 3.12(c) 'through November 2029' rep is inaccurate, creating indemnification exposure under Section 8.2(a).

Issue 2 identifies the 100% sale as a Change of Control requiring consent under Section 14.2, with a termination right under Section 14.3. It notes the consent is omitted from Schedule 3.6, so it falls outside Sections 6.4 and 7.1(d), and recommends adding it as a Required Consent and starting the consent request now.

Issue 4 identifies the six-state versus four-state mismatch, including the 18-month post-term period, and recommends narrowing the territory. It never states that the Side Letter's expanded definition controls under the Section 19.4 order-of-precedence clause; Section 19.4 is cited only in Issue 5 and not tied to the territory definition.

Issue 5 identifies New York law and New York County courts in the Side Letter against Delaware law and Wilmington courts under Sections 18.1 and 18.2. It explains the risk of conflicting analysis across forums and recommends a conforming amendment to align governing law and forum.
States the Initial Term ends November 14, 2026.
States the Target Closing Date is November 30, 2026.
States the Distribution Agreement Territory is Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey and Pennsylvania only.
The memo is addressed to the Partner. Each issue gives the documents and sections, why it matters, and a recommended fix.
The most significant issues come first. Items to raise promptly with the client and Quillon's counsel are explicitly flagged, and a priority table is included.
The response discusses renewal only conditionally and treats the deadline as passed. It never concludes that the agreement renewed or that the notice can still be timely delivered.
The response expressly states that Velloran's consent is not on Schedule 3.6 and is not a closing condition.
